sources.title: Sierra Leone Immigration Department: official eVisa service link
sources.officialityEvidence: SLID's live official homepage links evisa.sl as its official eVisa portal.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Apply online via the official Sierra Leone eVisa portal.

sources.title: Government of Sierra Leone eVisa: live terms and conditions
sources.officialityEvidence: SLID links to this live evisa.sl service. Its application asset supplies nationality, passport, email and arrival-issuance terms.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All countries except all members of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS).

sources.title: National Tourist Board: 2019 visa-on-arrival announcement
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official NTB page identifies this as a Government announcement dated 19 November 2019.
sources.supportingExcerpt: With effect from Thursday 5 September 2019, a new Visa on Arrival policy was rolled out.

sources.title: National Tourist Board-hosted 2025 visa-openness guidance
sources.publisher: Sierra Leone National Tourist Board / Ministry of Tourism and Cultural Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The official NTB domain hosts this November 2025 publication, which reports aggregate visa-free and VOA cohorts but no ordinary-passport schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 35 countries now qualify for visa-on-arrival arrangements. Only three countries require a visa before departure.

sources.title: Embassy of Sierra Leone in Kuwait: visa guidance
sources.officialityEvidence: This current Embassy page is on the official Sierra Leone government embassy domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tourists and other potential investors can now obtain Visas on Arrival in Sierra Leone.
